subtasks: Put all three chocolate bars into the middle blue basket.
Put both watches into the right red basket.
Put both toy cars, the yellow van and the green sports car, into the left white basket.
Use the left gripper to pick up the overturned yellow and turquoise van from the center of the table and place it inside the left white basket.
Place the green sports car in the left white basket. Use the right gripper to stage it on the center of the table for the left gripper to pick up and place.
Pick up the overturned green sports car lying on the right-center tabletop with the right hand and set it down gently on the left-center tabletop in front of the white basket for the left hand.
Use the left gripper to pick up the green sports car from the center of the table and place it fully inside the left white basket beside the van.
Regrasp the upside-down green sports car resting across the front rim of the left white basket. Lift it clear and place it fully inside the open left half of the same basket, beside the van.
Keep both grippers fully open, withdraw upward from the white basket, and return both arms to their respective episode-start poses without disturbing the sorted objects.
